title: Billing Calendar, Late Charge and Payment Fee Schedule — Independent Living
content:
The Business Office bills every Independent Living Residency Agreement on one calendar, with one schedule of late charges and payment fees. The figures below are identical for the Independent Living Studio, One-Bedroom, One-Bedroom Deluxe, Two-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom Deluxe and Cottage Home.

## Billing calendar

| Term | Figure (every apartment type) |
|---|---|
| Day of the month on which monthly fees are billed in advance and fall due | day 1 |
| Grace period after the due day during which a monthly fee may be paid without a late fee | 10 days |

## Late charges

| Term | Figure (every apartment type) |
|---|---|
| Flat component of the late fee | 75.00 USD |
| Percentage component of the late fee | 1.5% of the past-due amount for that billing period |
| Past-due amount for the billing period below which no late fee is assessed | 100.00 USD |
| Late fees that may be waived on request as goodwill in any rolling 12-month window | 1 |

The flat component and the percentage component are the two components of the late fee: the late fee is the greater of the two.

## Payment fees and restrictions

| Term | Figure (every apartment type) |
|---|---|
| Fee for a payment returned unpaid by the bank (insufficient funds, closed account, stop payment) | 35.00 USD per returned payment |
| Returned payments in a rolling 12-month window after which only certified funds or ACH autopay are accepted | 2 |
| Convenience fee on a credit card payment | 2.9% of the card payment amount |

## Nonpayment periods

| Term | Figure (every apartment type) |
|---|---|
| Calendar days a monthly fee may remain past due before a written notice of discharge for nonpayment may be issued | 60 |
| Length of the written notice of discharge for nonpayment | 30 calendar days |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A card payment of 1,000.00 carries a convenience fee of 29.00 (2.9 percent of 1,000.00).
- Two returned payments posted three months apart bring a residency to the count of 2 returned payments within a rolling 12-month window.
